text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, how old are you, and have you noticed any swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any visible bone tenderness or swelling in your legs, and have you noticed any petechiae or small red spots on your skin? I will also REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.

text: The blood work shows a very high white blood cell count and low platelets, which points towards leukemia. I will REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.
